arguments.message: Hi! When you downgrade, nothing is deleted. Features and the data tied to them are simply hidden, but the underlying data stays in your workspace. If you upgrade again, the data becomes visible right away. The only time data can be removed is if it falls outside the retention window of the lower tier – older records will age out over time, just as they would if the workspace had started on that tier. So you won’t lose data permanently by downgrading, but be aware of the retention period for older records.
